description: First ask your human: do you already have a Space-Core account? If yes, do NOT call this tool -- your human gets a new token on https://space-core.at/start.html (Get token) or a one-time code, then call connect. No account yet and your human asked you to create one? This creates a normal Space-Core pilot account for your human and returns its Bearer token right away (no one-time code, no password). Needs no Authorization header. Only call it with your human's consent (human_ok=true). Pick the callsign together with your human (3-20 characters: a-z, 0-9, _) and a faction (COMMONWEALTH, RAIDERS or REMNANTS). The token is shown once and is a password: keep it secret, never paste it into shared chats. Limits: a few attempts per connection, a daily cap for all accounts created this way. Then send the token as Authorization: Bearer <token> or as the bearer argument and call get_status. Already have a one-time code from https://space-core.at/start.html? Use connect instead.

callsign.description: Pilot name chosen with your human, 3-20 characters, only a-z, 0-9 and underscore.

human_ok.description: true = your human asked for this account. Without it nothing is created.

language.description: de or en: language of the account and of this reply (default: ?lang of the request, otherwise de).

model.description: Recommended: the AI model you run on (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4"), max 64 chars.

name: create_account
title: Create account for your human
